title.en:
A Century of Inquiry,
Into the Next

lead.zh: 1928 年 6 月 9 日創立於南京，2028 年 6 月 9 日迎接創院百年。
lead.en: Founded in Nanjing on 9 June 1928, Academia Sinica turns 100 on 9 June 2028.

mark_caption.zh: 一百年的影像，拼成一個 100
mark_caption.en: A hundred years of images, forming one 100

heading.zh: 一百年，這裡從未停止提問
heading.en: A hundred years of asking questions

text.zh: 從南京到南港，從一間庫房到三大學組與數十個研究所及中心。院慶形象影片製作中，以下先連到本院公開的簡介影片。
text.en: From Nanjing to Nangang, from a single warehouse to three divisions and dozens of institutes. The anniversary film is in production; below is the public introduction video.

alt.en: A speaker at the podium in a lecture hall, with portraits of past presidents on screen
